nodes.description: External caller address used for authorization checks, allowance ownership and token sender context.
Privileged owner address assigned in constructor and used as gate for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Whitelisted trading address written by setTradeAddress and read by ensure().
Hardcoded Uniswap router constant whitelisted in ensure().
Public balance mapping mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public allowance mapping mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and compared in condition().
Whitelist flag set in _mints and consumed by ensure().
Minimum sale amount configured in init and enforced in condition().
Maximum sale amount configured in init and enforced in condition().
Per-address sale limit configured in init and enforced in condition().
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Constant 18 decimals used to scale minted and configured amounts.
Public payable entry that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer routine: allowance check, ensure() gate and manual balance arithmetic.
Writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any validation.
Whitelist gate checking owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale, otherwise calling condition().
Sale restriction logic based on _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary low-level delegatecall to a caller-supplied address.
Privileged mint/whitelist function writing balanceOf and canSale.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution with unchecked total = _value * _tos.length.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Deterministic Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure().
Constructor assigning name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and infinite UNI allowance.
SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level call to the token address.
Arbitrary delegatecall of user-supplied calldata to a user-supplied address inside delegate().
Low-level address(token).call(data) with external return data decoding.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Unchecked balance/allowance subtraction and addition arithmetic in transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer, transferFrom and batchSend.
Sender address parameter of transferFrom and ensure.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Mint amount parameter of _mints.
Sale count parameter of init.
Minimum sale token parameter of init.
Maximum sale token parameter of init.
Recipient array parameter of batchSend.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Delegatecall target address parameter of delegate.
Delegatecall calldata parameter of delegate.
Local unchecked total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop index local of batchSend.
Per-iteration recipient local of batchSend.
Encoded calldata parameter of callOptionalReturn.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument when transfer() calls transferFrom().
transferFrom branches on msg.sender != _from and requires an allowance for msg.sender.
approve() stores the allowance under msg.sender as owner.
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints() is guarded by require(msg.sender==owner || msg.sender==fixed address).
init() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender becomes owner and initial token holder in the constructor.
owner is compared against msg.sender to authorize delegate().
owner is compared against msg.sender to authorize _mints().
owner is compared against msg.sender to authorize init().
owner is compared against msg.sender to authorize batchSend().
owner is compared against msg.sender to authorize setTradeAddress().
owner is an explicit whitelisted address in ensure().
owner state variable is written in the constructor.
UNI constant is compared with _from inside ensure().
tradeAddress is compared with _from inside ensure().
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
canSale[_from] is read by ensure() to bypass the sale condition.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true.
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum inside condition().
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
_minSale is enforced against _value inside condition().
init writes the _minSale configuration value.
_maxSale is enforced against _value inside condition().
init writes the _maxSale configuration value.
_saleNum is compared against _onSaleNum inside condition().
init writes the _saleNum configuration value.
transferFrom reads and mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
_mints writes balanceOf[spender].
batchSend reads and mutates balanceOf for sender and recipients.
constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] to totalSupply.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
constructor computes and stores totalSupply.
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
init scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom().
ensure() falls back to condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() derives a pair address via pairFor() for whitelist comparison.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to return true.
delegate() performs an arbitrary low-level delegatecall to a caller-controlled address.
callOptionalReturn executes address(token).call(data) against an external contract.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
transferFrom mutates balances and allowance with raw unchecked arithmetic.
The delegatecall target can re-enter transferFrom before state updates settle.
The external token call can re-enter callOptionalReturn / SafeERC20 flows.
_to parameter flows into transfer().
_to parameter is credited in transferFrom().
_value parameter flows into transfer().
_value parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom().
_from parameter supplies the debited account and allowance owner.
_spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve().
addedValue parameter is minted into balanceOf[spender].
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum.
token parameter is stored into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is stored into _maxSale.
_tos array parameter drives the batchSend loop and length multiplier.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
address parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate().
bytes parameter b is the delegatecall calldata in delegate().
data parameter is the payload executed by callOptionalReturn.
Local total holds the unguarded _value * _tos.length product.
Loop index i controls iteration in batchSend.
Local _to receives each batch recipient balance credit.
_value is a multiplier of the unchecked total in batchSend.
_tos.length is a multiplier of the unchecked total in batchSend.
Parameter a is the arbitrary delegatecall target executed by the unsafe operation.
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata executed by the delegatecall.
Parameter data is forwarded into the low-level external call.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter is only meaningful as an argument of the transferFrom function.
Amount parameter is normalized into the transferFrom amount handling.
Sender parameter is normalized into the transferFrom debit path.
Spender parameter is solely the key written by approve.
Mint amount parameter belongs to the privileged _mints function.
Sale count parameter is written into _saleNum by init.
Minimum sale parameter is written into _minSale by init.
Maximum sale parameter is written into _maxSale by init.
Recipient array parameter is consumed only by the batchSend loop.
Address parameter is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
Target address parameter is normalized into the delegate delegatecall handling.
Calldata parameter is normalized into the delegate delegatecall handling.
Local total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
Loop index local is scoped to the batchSend iteration.
Per-iteration recipient local is scoped to the batchSend loop.
Encoded calldata parameter is executed by the SafeERC20 low-level call helper.
